2610.05601.title: Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models
2610.05601.paper_summary: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.
2610.05601.paper_summary_zh: 現有對未學習擴散模型的攻擊假設被刪除的概念是事先已知的，並專注於恢復這些概念。 然而，在實際情況中，模型提供者可能不會透露哪些概念已被移除，即使擁有原始基礎模型的訪問權限，對手仍然可能缺乏明確的攻擊目標。 在本文中，我們旨在回答以下關鍵但被忽視的問題：哪些概念已從模型中刪除，以及總共刪除了多少個？ 為此，我們提出了 Tracer，一個快速且準確識別被刪除概念並估算其數量的框架。 Tracer 高效地識別被刪除的概念，而無需生成和分類圖像。 通過結合輕量級的權重足跡光譜分析，它能夠在大型候選詞彙中進行高效搜索。 為了區分多個被刪除的概念，我們引入了一個足跡覆蓋目標，以指導順序發現。 Tracer 通過檢測候選信心的急劇下降來估算被刪除的概念數量，因為所選概念佔據了刪除的足跡，而無需標記示例進行校準。 該框架僅需要輕量級的線性代數和有限的前向探測，無需對未學習算法的先驗知識。 在文本到圖像和文本到視頻的基礎上，以及多種未學習方法的實驗表明，Tracer 在幾秒鐘內識別被刪除的概念並估算其數量，實現了相對於圖像和視頻模型中 MIA 和暴力搜索的 150 到 137,000 倍和 133 到 20,000 倍的加速，並且識別準確性顯著提高。
